paper_title: Searching for axion-like particles with ultra-peripheral heavy-ion collisions
notes: From Fig. 4 left panel (aFF-tilde coupling), moneyplot.pdf in the arXiv e-print, extracted by vector-path digitisation. y-axis is 1/Lambda [GeV^-1]; with L = -(1/4)(a/Lambda) F Ftilde (Eq.1) this equals the canonical g_agamma exactly (g_agamma = 1/Lambda, no factor). The paper's PRIMARY headline (green Pb-Pb 1 nb^-1 / 10 nb^-1 curves) is an EXPECTED sensitivity PROJECTION for future heavy-ion UPC runs and is out of scope; those are NOT reported here. Reported instead is the paper's genuinely NEW/updated DERIVED exclusion: the combined lower (most-stringent) envelope of the four newly recast collider limits shown as shaded regions: OPAL inclusive 2-gamma (flat 1.26e-3, ~0.05-8 GeV; the explicitly new derivation improving on prior LEPI-based bounds), ATLAS 3-gamma (~10-60 GeV), OPAL 3-gamma (>20 GeV) and ATLAS 2-gamma (>60 GeV). Excluded from the envelope are the CMS 36 pb^-1 (shown for comparison, external) and beam-dump (external) regions. Hybrid x-axis: log below 5 GeV, linear above; calibrated from axis tick labels and cross-checked (OPAL 2g line reproduces the ~1.2e-3 plotted value). 95% CL per text. Collider search, no DM-density dependence.
